name: The Source Family
tagline: A vegetarian restaurant on the Sunset Strip, a commune in the Hollywood Hills.
summary: Grow the commune to 140 members and earn $50,000 of restaurant profit while keeping the family loyal.
action.run_restaurant.desc: Serve the Strip. Adds funds and profit.
action.record_album.desc: The house band plays. Recruiting works 1.5x better for 30 minutes, but people start to notice.
codex.fall.scattered: The real Source Family scattered after Jim Baker died in a hang-gliding accident in Hawaii in August 1975. No one else was hurt; members drifted back to ordinary life over the following years.
codex.fall.raided: Neighbours, police and the press closed in, and the commune broke up under the pressure. (Game ending; the real group broke up after its leader's death in 1975.)
